verdict.rationale: CDP Payments documents programmatic payouts from a custodial account to onchain addresses, including paying out USDC to any wallet via the CLI or SDK. Its transfers track the lifecycle from initiation through completion or failure, with upfront fee quotes. The evidence does not show stored or saved recipient objects, only email recipients, and does not detail status states through final onchain settlement, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented stored/saved recipient payouts, an explicit transfer status model through final settlement (e.g., confirmation/finality states), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send stablecoin payouts programmatically — pay a wallet address or stored recipient through the API with documented status tracking to final settlement

citations.quote: Send payouts and disbursements from a custodial account to onchain addresses, email recipients, or bank accounts via fiat rails.
Fund a USD treasury and pay out USDC onchain to any wallet, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
They provide upfront fee quotes and track the complete lifecycle from initiation through completion or failure.
